text:
cleo_marketing: heads-up team  planning announce Tues 10:00 PT for Sequencer perf release. marketing needs changelog + docs link + 1-line perf stat for socials by EOD tomorrow. can eng confirm? :calendar:

dan_eng: changelog PR ready to merge, docs drafted. i'll tag @anya_product for the "what this means" bullets.

anya_product: will review docs this afternoon and add a short migration note + one-line support blurb. webinar live demo Wed 11am PT sounds good to me.

marco_release: rollout plan: canary precheck 09:50 PT, embargo lift 10:05 PT, full ramp 12:00 PT. publishing-bot will run the precheck at 09:45 PT.

publishing-bot: Precheck scheduled: start=2026-10-05T09:45:00Z, target=canary-seq-1, alert=#eng-oncall if fail.

dan_eng: perf shortline draft: "Sequencer reduces median inference latency ~17% at 512 tokens; typical unit cost down ~20% with default batching." use for teaser.

cleo_marketing: great  i'll draft social + newsletter with that line. marketing asks changelog to include a curl example and a clear "what to tell customers" sentence.

dan_eng: adding curl snippet to changelog now: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"sequencer-v1","prompt":"Summarize"}'
```

marco_release: rollback triggers for slide: sustained error rate >1% for 5m or P95 >2x baseline for 10m. i'll paste exact wording into the rollout doc by 5pm PT.

cleo_marketing: timeline recap: EOD tomorrow = changelog merged + docs reviewed + perf line locked, 09:45 PT precheck, 09:50 PT canary start, 10:05 PT embargo lift, Wed 11am PT webinar. confirm here and i'll lock calendar. :white_check_mark:

dan_eng: confirmed from eng, merging PR now.

anya_product: confirmed  slides + support line uploaded to drive.

cleo_marketing: note: if numbers change, prefix updates in this thread with "update:" so we don't ship wrong metrics.

dan_eng: update: final perf pass nudged median improvement to 15%. updating PR and docs now.

cleo_marketing: got it  will use 15% in copy. thanks all :rocket:
